args.root_cause: In calculate_tax, the tax amount is quantized to cents with rounding=ROUND_DOWN (truncation) instead of half-up rounding. When the raw tax lands exactly on or above a half-cent boundary (e.g. 10.00 * 0.0725 = 0.7250 -> should be 0.73), the value is truncated, producing one cent less. The test file explicitly expects half-up behavior ("rounds half up to the cent"), so the ROUND_DOWN choice contradicts the intended spec. The fix is to use ROUND_HALF_UP (import it from decimal) in the quantize call in library/tax.py.
